jobs.title: Senior Full Stack
jobs.description: Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

jobs.description: Most of what we design is operational software. Someone opens it because they have a job to finish, such as checking why a device stopped reporting, running a screening, or provisioning a batch of units before they ship. Run the research that decides what gets built, including user interviews, task analysis, and testing a prototype before it turns into a sprint. Work alongside engineers while they build it, since our teams are small and design decisions reach production within days. What we look for: A portfolio with complex interfaces in it, such as dashboards, admin tools, or operational software. You're comfortable designing inside an existing component library and its constraints. You hand off work an engineer can build, and you stay available while they build it. Nice to have: Design tokens and theming across more than one product. Enough front-end familiarity to prototype in HTML, CSS, or Vue. Accessibility work against WCAG, including keyboard and screen reader paths. Data visualization, especially time series and fleet-scale tables. Designing for TV, kiosk, or embedded displays. Regulated domains such as healthcare or fintech, where a flow has to satisfy more than the user.

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer
jobs.description: About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. About the role Hi, my name is Matt Wensing, VP of Product & Design at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Principal Product Designer. Principal Product Designer is the highest individual contributor design role at Customer.io . This person shapes the design vision for the company and influences how design is practiced here — through their own craft, through the standards their work sets, and through the partnerships they build with product and engineering leadership. Customer.io is in a transformational moment: executing against a strong current product while redesigning what the product is and how it's experienced by a new generation of builders. This role has to straddle both — delivering quality and coherence in what exists today while driving the vision for where things go. This is not a management role, but it's a leadership role in the fullest sense. Their influence is felt company-wide — in the product, in the culture, and in who we hire. About you You have a fully formed point of view on how AI changes what software means — for the people who use it, the people who build it, and the agents that increasingly operate it. You have the conviction to put that view to work across a product and an organization. You lead through clarity and example, give candid feedback that improves the work, and operate with humility and curiosity even outside your own expertise. What we value Leads through clarity and example, not control. You shape culture through your own practice — not top-down direction. Candid craft feedback. You give feedback that improves the work, even when it's uncomfortable. Humility and curiosity. You operate with openness, especially in areas outside your expertise. Amplifying others. You raise the impact of people across the whole company — not just the design team. Bias for craft. You stay close to the work by choice, and that proximity is how you lead. Some things you'll do Shape and communicate a design vision for Customer.io 's product as a whole — the coherent, long-range picture of what excellent looks like for our customers, brought into rooms where product direction gets set Drive the strategic direction of Pluma , our design system — architecture, evolution, deprecation decisions, and the principles that govern how it scales Close the gap between design intent and shipped product — stay close enough to implementation to catch divergence, and fix it directly when code is the right tool Design for builder and developer audiences — CLI-native flows, API-first onboarding, and interfaces built for people who type before they click Lead the design of agentic and human-AI surfaces across the product — develop the philosophy and advocate for the standards Partner with product and engineering leadership on product strategy — bring design into the conversation before direction is set, not after Develop and advocate for Customer.io 's AI product design philosophy as a framework the whole team builds from Lead design review for major initiatives and bring accountability for quality and coherence across what ships Develop Staff designers through direct mentorship, critique, and the clarity of your own example Contribute to hiring and calibration — assess candidates with conviction and help the team develop a shared language for what excellent looks like What we're looking for 10+ years of product design experience with a portfolio demonstrating design vision and organizational impact, not just individual craft Track record of shaping design direction at the company level — influenced what gets built and why, not just how it looks Designed for developer and builder audiences — CLI, API-first onboarding, or infrastructure-native products Developed point of view on AI and agentic product design — has shipped AI-native interfaces and can articulate a philosophy on interaction models for agentic and delegated use Contributed to a design system at the strategic level — shaped what it should be and shouldn't be, and advocated for those decisions over time Operates with influence without authority — track record of aligning product, engineering, and exec leadership around a design direction without a management title Has raised the craft bar at an organizational level — through critique culture, standards, and the example others internalize Executive-level communication — connects design decisions to customer impact, product differentiation, and business outcomes B2B SaaS depth — understands complex, data-heavy products and has opinions about where the interaction model breaks Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. The starting salary for this role is $245k-$276k USD , depending on experience and subject to market-rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build. We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks of paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions — just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 30 minute call with Recruiter 45 minute call and portfolio review with Hiring Manager 30 minute call with cross-functional partner 60 minute design case call with members of the design & tech team All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact. Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions, please contact jobs@customer.io . Join us! Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

We decided to build Finch hoping to make self-care fun and accessible after seeing many others share similar struggles. Finch was launched in 2021, and our team is grateful to have helped over 20 million people on their mental health journeys. Finch is profitable and we believe in responsible growth. We are a small but mighty team who are passionate about mental health. Role Summary Finch has unique design opportunities as it straddles the line between wellness and gaming, and our design challenges reflect that. We’re passionate about making self-care feel easy and fun for everyone, and strive to design playful, delightful experiences we hope users will love. If those sorts of creative challenges are interesting to you, read on! Key Responsibilities Design playful & delightful flows, interactions, and high-fidelity visuals for mental health exercises, gaming mechanics, and growth loops. Prototype concrete solutions to ambiguous product challenges. Create new design patterns that are intuitive and practical. Evolve our design system intentionally as we scale. Design product concepts that balance product vision, speed, and business potential. Work cross-functionally with engineering, product management, character design and character animation. How can we create playful product experiences that can make daily self care and mental health fun and sustainably engaging? How can we create a generalizable platform of mental health tools that can cater to a wide range of experiences, from people still figuring out their self care routines to others who know exactly what they need to do? Requirements 4+ years industry experience designing consumer mobile apps at scale Ability to untangle vague conceptual problems, and have a sharp intuition for the most accessible mental models and flows, so users can immediately start gaining value out of the product. Pragmatic about the implications and practicality of your designs. You don't get stuck on pretty UI or deep abstractions, and can balance between craft, speed, and product goals. Ability to internalize all inputs and feedback to help you reach an optimal decision for the team and mission. Big plus if you have hands-on experience with coding, illustration and/or game design. You will have significant input into the norms and tools we use in order to create a high performing engineering team. You will work cross-functionally with product designers, creative designers, character animators, and the founders. You will be a thought partner in building a product, company, and culture we are proud of. Projects You Could Work On How can we revolutionize the way people interact with their mobile devices to be mentally beneficial instead of mentally degrading? How can we redefine social interactions that can help people support others in a way that no other product can? How can we reimagine wellness exercises like CBT, mental health insights, and more to help people navigate the ups and downs in their lives? How can we create playful product experiences that can make daily self care and mental health fun and sustainably engaging? How can we create a generalizable platform of mental health tools that can cater to a wide range of experiences, from people still figuring out their self care routines to others who know exactly what they need to do? You are familiar with best practices in engineering for mobile apps and web and can help build scalable and reliable products. You enjoy disentangling ambiguous and messy problems into simple and elegant solutions. You can work at least 6 hours within our coordination hours (8am PST - 6pm PST) Nice to haves: Experience developing Flutter mobile apps. Experience working on products in the wellness or game industry. jobs.description: Who are we? At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Most designers ship a page and never find out its impact. Here, you'll find out every week. We're putting together a growth squad: a small team of growth marketers, developers and one designer, with one job. Work out what turns a visitor into a customer, then do more of it. You'll be that designer. You'll pitch ideas, design landing pages, page sections and sign-up flows we test, and see the results on every one. You'll work inside an established design system and help shape what gets added to it, with AI built into how you prototype and ship. About 80-90% of your time will be on the web. The rest goes to the bigger creative moments that support it, like interactive tools, launch pages and more. Those bigger moments are where we want to push. We rebuilt our brand in 2025 and we want the best website in cybersecurity. That means interactive product demos, scroll-driven stories and free tools other designers wish they'd made. What will you do? Design and ship a steady stream of website experiments: landing pages, page variants, UI modules, forms and CTAs, each built to test a clear hypothesis against a clear metric. Bring your own test ideas to the squad. Spot the opportunity in the data, write the hypothesis, and shape the brief alongside our growth marketers, performance marketing, SEO and web developers. Push what our website can do. Design interactive, world-class web experiences (product demos in the browser, scroll-driven stories, free tools, calculators and launch pages) that raise the bar for B2B web design. Turn a complex security product into a story people follow. Use real UI, product vignettes and motion to walk visitors from the problem they have to how UpGuard fixes it. Grow our design system with what you learn. Build every test from the system first, and when a new pattern wins, turn it into a component the whole team can use. Design landing pages for paid campaigns with tight message matches to the ads driving traffic to them. Prototype fast with AI tools, in Figma or in code, so the squad can click through an idea before a developer builds it. Hand off build-ready designs to our web developers and QA what ships for responsiveness, accessibility and page speed. Review the results of every test, wins and losses, and turn what we learn into a playbook of what converts. What will you bring? 5+ years designing websites and marketing pages, with a portfolio that shows both craft and outcomes: pages you tested and improved, and at least one interactive or high-craft experience you're proud of. A proven track record working in or alongside growth or performance marketing teams. You can walk us through tests you've designed, what won, what lost, and what you changed next. Deep experience designing inside an existing design system in Figma (components, variants, auto layout, variables), and the judgement to know when a new component earns its place. Sharp UI and interaction craft: layout, typography, hierarchy, motion and responsive design that holds up from mobile to wide desktop. Taste you'll stand behind. jobs.title: Staff FullStack Engineer - Application Core Services | Canada | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada. The Opportunity: Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise. The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculations, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts. This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana Cloud scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana Labs also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope. What You’ll Be Doing: The Usage squad owns the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations and customer usage calculations. Our domain encompasses maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, cost management and billing applications, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the customer user portal. Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. We build full-stack web applications, customer portals, backend services, APIs, and data integrations across internal Grafana platforms and third-party systems like NetSuite and Salesforce. When this domain works well, customers get clear usage visibility, reliable billing, and seamless account management workflows. This role is about 75% FrontEnd and 25% BackEnd. Design, build, operate, and evolve reliable full-stack web applications, customer-facing account portals, and backend services that power core customer usage and billing workflows Build and maintain backend APIs (Golang, Node.js) and intuitive user interfaces using modern frontend technologies (TypeScript, React) Design and maintain integrations between Grafana systems and external business platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP) Develop and automate business logic for customer usage metering, pricing structures, promotions, and billing reconciliation Collaborate across product management, DealOps, GTM, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads to deliver robust end-to-end features Address technical debt, optimize CI/CD pipelines, strengthen test coverage, and improve system observability and operational resilience Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while shaping pragmatic solutions for complex systems challenges Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks What Makes You a Great Fit: At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe. We are seeking a Staff FullStack Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and user experience are paramount. As a remote-first organization, you should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously across time zones and taking full ownership of the critical systems powering Grafana Cloud. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain. You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams. Some things you might be expected to do could include: Writing efficient, readable, and easy to maintain code Designing new microservices or systems Collaborating with teammates and other departments to reach consensus on proposed solutions Coordinating with product and UX when needed Responding to customer requests and feedback When ready, participating in our follow-the-sun OnCall rotation Participating in team decisions, such as roadmap planning and prioritization Requirements: You have at least 1 year of fully remote work experience You have worked on a big SaaS platform and dealt with common distributed systems problems (e.g. scalability, multi-tenancy, data isolation, HA, …) Strong professional experience with backend technologies (Golang, Node.js) as well as modern frontend web development (TypeScript, React) Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on Have some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, and brainstorming ideas to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way You write clean, robust, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, operate, and maintain Have experience with mentoring junior engineers in a collaborative but asynchronous environment Can take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve tight learning loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively You are willing to work across teams. Your work has to be aligned with the needs of other squads and external stakeholders. You make your plans transparent, bring stakeholders on board, and are open to feedback and suggestions Strong Kubernetes experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.) Bonus Points For: Experience with high-volume usage metering, billing engines, or customer-facing cost management applications Experience designing, building, and maintaining integrations with third-party business systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Cloud Marketplaces) Experience with frontend component libraries, design systems, and modern CSS-in-JS tooling Familiarity with cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS provisioning/tenancy patterns Experience working on SaaS provisioning, tenancy, regional expansion, plugin rollout, or customer lifecycle systems Experience with incident response involving configuration drift, partial failure, or cross-service state mismatch In Canada, the compensation range for this role is $186,368 - $223,642 CAD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

jobs.description: Über Protofy Wir sind Protofy, die Outcome Agency aus Hamburg, und entwickeln seit über 10 Jahren digitale Produkte, Plattformen und KI-Systeme, die messbar wirken. Technologie ist für uns kein Selbstzweck, sondern ein Business Case, den wir in Umsatz, Effizienz und Wachstum übersetzen. Deine Rolle Als technische*r Lead führst Du engagierte Teams und sorgst dafür, dass auch komplexe Projekte pragmatisch, sorgfältig und wirtschaftlich umgesetzt werden. Wir entwickeln Websites und Mobile-Apps für Branchen wie E-Commerce, Wissensmanagement und Sport. Unsere Projekte laufen drei bis neun Monate oder werden als Produkte langfristig weiterentwickelt. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin mit und hast ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Architektur. Den Entscheider*innen unserer Kund*innen begegnest Du auf Augenhöhe: Du leitest Architekturworkshops eigenständig und unterstützt uns bei Pitches. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg*innen aus Produkt Designer*innen und Product Owner*innen verantwortest Du Spezifikation, Umsetzung, Testing und Deployment von Features. Neue Technologien erschließt Du hands-on und machst sie für das Team nutzbar. Außerdem gestaltest Du professionelle Standards in der gesamten Organisation mit, insbesondere für KI-gestützte Entwicklung. Den Großteil Deiner Zeit arbeitest Du selbst im Code, daneben übernimmst Du Führung, Kundenkontakt und Themen der Organisation. Deine typische Woche Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner*in für die Entscheider*innen unserer Kund*innen und berätst sie strategisch Du unterstützt Pitches, erarbeitest Slides und technische Konzepte und präsentierst sie Du führst Projekte technisch ganzheitlich, von der Architektur bis zum Deployment Du entwirfst neue Funktionen mit Produktmanager*innen und UX-Designer*innen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit Deinem Team um Du baust neue Themen und Technologien hands-on im Projekt auf, z. B. neue Shopsysteme, Frameworks oder Cloud-Provider Du begleitest Dein Team, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst Deine Kolleg*innen durch Tech-Mentoring Du gestaltest Entwicklungsprozesse pragmatisch mit, insbesondere KI-gestützte Entwicklung (Tools, Workflows, Qualitätssicherung) Du behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick: Du schätzt Aufwände, achtest auf Budgets und unterstützt das Projektmanagement Du entwickelst die gesamte Organisation aktiv mit Das bringst du mit Du hast 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Web- oder App-Entwicklung Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung als Tech Lead bzw. in der technischen Führung von Teams Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der technischen Verantwortung mittelgroßer Projekte (500+ Personentage) Du hast Erfahrung mit Application Architecture und begleitest Teams dabei, Anwendungen auf der grünen Wiese aufzusetzen Du kannst Projekte ganzheitlich technisch führen Du behältst auch in intensiven Projektphasen einen klaren Kopf und gehst gelassen mit Unsicherheit um Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung über Deine eigene Arbeit hinaus und lernst gern Neues Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch Deine ersten Monate bei Protofy In deinen ersten Wochen wirst du dich in unsere bestehenden Projekte und Architekturkonzepte einarbeiten und erste Features für unsere Kund*innen umsetzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit dem Team aus und übernimmst schrittweise die Verantwortung für die technische Ausrichtung von Web-Anwendungen. Wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen auf Anhieb erfüllst, aber das nötige Fundament mitbringst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Das bieten wir dir Dich erwartet ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag bei einer wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit von 40 Stunden und einer Probezeit von 6 Monaten sowie 29 Urlaubstagen im Jahr. Wir unterstützen deine berufliche Bildung und bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit zum vollständigen Remote-Arbeiten oder im Homeoffice, wofür wir dir eine passende Home-Office-Ausstattung und einen Firmenlaptop zur Verfügung stellen. Zusätzlich profitierst du von Betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, einem Fitnessabo, einer Entschädigung für Reisekosten, Vorteilen bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, einem Sabbatical, Unterstützung der psychischen Gesundheit, Mitarbeiterrabatten sowie regelmäßigen Teamevents und Firmenfeiern. Vor Ort oder remote erwarten dich zudem kostenlose Getränke, kostenlose Snacks, eine lockere Kleiderordnung und die Möglichkeit, Haustiere mitzubringen. jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: ## Overview of the position We are looking for an experienced Design Engineer to join us. You would be working with our team of engineers and designers on agentic experiences: products, technologies and client projects where AI does real work alongside the people using it. If you're a design oriented tinkerer, either a designer with development skills or a developer with a strong knack for design, you'll probably find interesting things to build with us. Most of our client work happens directly in the client's codebase, not in design files handed over to developers. You'd design the interface and ship it yourself, working alongside our engineers. The position is remote-first within Europe. You need to live in the EU/EEA, UK or Switzerland, somewhere between UK and Finnish time, and be authorised to work there. We don't sponsor visas or relocation. We hope to get some face time at company retreats, and you're welcome to join our office in Turku. ## Key Responsibilities - Design and build interfaces for agentic products, from concept to production. - Work directly in client codebases alongside our engineers. - Prototype and test ideas with clients and users. - Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code and Codex every day, and keep looking for better ways to work with emerging tooling. ## Must-have Skills and Qualifications - At least five years of professional experience in front-end development or design engineering. - Good eye for high class UX & UI. - Conceptual thinking and, above all, a passion for problem solving. - Front-end technologies: React, TypeScript. - At home in a real codebase: you can find your way around an unfamiliar repo, work with Git and pull requests, and connect a UI to an API. - A portfolio or other showcase of UI work you've designed and built. - Excited about pushing the limits of agentic experiences and finding the interaction patterns that don't exist yet. - Professional working proficiency in English and clear communication, in writing and with clients. - Experience with generative AI and with Figma or similar design tools. - Back-end or full-stack knowledge is not mandatory, but a plus. - Finnish language skills are not mandatory, but a plus. ## What We Offer - A stimulating environment where you can build state-of-the-art agentic experiences. - Competitive salary with final compensation negotiated based on skills and experience. - Work-life balance with the option to work remotely or from our office in Turku. - Regular team events, off-sites, and the national holidays of your country of residence. - Five weeks of paid vacation per year. - Salary range: ~ 5,500–6,500 € per month. ## How to apply [Apply now](https://airtable.com/app1IdYEA8icQy9UG/pagW3lN9yNnILKhYv/form?prefill_fld1XkXus2hnXAePH=recCceE34kqfUovFS) and include in your application: - Detailed answers to all open questions listed in the form. - A portfolio or showcase of your UI work. - Links to relevant projects or content in GitHub, X, LinkedIn, etc. - Your salary expectations and potential starting date. Applications without an attached or linked design portfolio won't be reviewed. A lot of our work is user interface design, so lead with your best UX and UI work. A few well-chosen projects show taste better than a long list.

jobs.title: Web Designer
jobs.location: Argentina; Brazil; Colombia; Costa Rica; Jamaica; Mexico
jobs.description: Web Designer Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S Business Hours About the Role We’re looking for a skilled Web Designer to create polished, user-centered web experiences that balance visual quality with usability. You’ll translate briefs and product goals into wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes, ensuring designs are responsive, consistent, and ready for development. Working closely with developers and stakeholders, you’ll own your designs from initial concept through implementation review. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented designer who takes pride in their work, communicates proactively, and can manage projects independently in a remote, asynchronous environment. What You’ll Own Visual Design & Prototyping Translate project briefs and product goals into clear, user-centered web designs. Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to communicate design concepts before development begins. Balance visual appeal, usability, and business objectives across web experiences. Responsive Web Design Design and refine layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens. Apply responsive design principles to deliver consistent experiences across devices. Consider how layouts and interactions translate into HTML and CSS. Design System Maintenance Contribute to and improve the existing design system. Maintain consistency across components, typography, colors, spacing, and layouts. Use component libraries and reusable design elements to support efficient workflows. Developer Collaboration & Handoff Work closely with front-end developers to ensure accurate design implementation. Provide clear specifications, assets, and guidance for layouts and interactions. Answer implementation questions and resolve design-related issues during development. Feedback & Iteration Incorporate stakeholder and user feedback into design revisions. Refine designs efficiently while keeping the original project goals in focus. Ask clarifying questions and communicate potential blockers early. Design Quality Assurance Review implemented pages against approved designs. Identify visual inconsistencies, layout issues, and usability concerns. Recommend fixes to maintain a high standard of design quality. Required Experience & Skills Professional experience in web design, supported by a portfolio demonstrating strong visual judgment, layout skills, and attention to detail. Proficiency in a modern design tool such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD. Experience with component libraries, reusable components, and auto-layout workflows. Solid understanding of responsive design principles and how designs translate into HTML and CSS. Familiarity with UX fundamentals, including information architecture, user flows, accessibility, and usability. Strong written and spoken English for clear communication with distributed teams and stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines independently. Strong attention to detail and willingness to refine work based on feedback. What Makes You a Strong Fit You take pride in producing polished, thoughtful design work and maintain high standards without constant supervision. You communicate proactively, clarify requirements early, and keep collaborators informed. You respond constructively to feedback and focus on delivering the best outcome for users and the business. You work effectively in an asynchronous environment and manage your workload reliably. You collaborate well with developers and understand the importance of accurate design handoffs. You take ownership of your designs from concept through final implementation review. What Success Looks Like High-quality, user-centered web designs that align with project goals. Responsive layouts that deliver consistent experiences across devices. A well-maintained design system with reusable, consistent components. Clear handoffs that help developers implement designs accurately. Timely, thoughtful revisions based on feedback. Implemented pages that closely match approved designs and meet quality expectations. Typical Day You’ll begin by reviewing feedback and comments on active design files and prioritizing your work. Depending on project needs, you may refine a landing page, develop a reusable design component, or revise a product interface. You may also meet with a developer to discuss a design handoff or clarify an interaction. Later in the day, you’ll review completed work for quality, update project notes, and document progress so teammates across time zones can continue smoothly. Interview Process Initial Screening Recruiter Interview Client Interview Offer & Onboarding #LI-AG1

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Full Stack Engineer San Francisco / Hybrid/Remote About Nash Logistics is the substrate beneath every economy that has ever existed, and it remains the least intelligently coordinated activity in the modern world. Consumer expectations are converging on instantaneous, perfect, free. Networks are not. We call this gap the Logistics Singularity, and closing it is the work. Nash is the Autonomic Logistics OS. We unify decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable system that pursues a business’s objectives continuously, adapts as conditions change, and runs the operation at equilibrium across orders, fleets, carriers, providers, and customers. The world’s largest retailers, grocers, and pharmacies (including Walmart, 7-Eleven, Woolworths, and Coles) run their critical workflows on Nash. Founded by Mahmoud Ghulman and Aziz Alghunaim, and backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are based in San Francisco. About the Role We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to design and build the Nash portal: the surface where operators see the autonomic system at work. Every order in flight, every delivery in motion, every route being continuously optimized as conditions on the ground change. You will own features end to end across React and Python, working directly with our VP of Engineering, CTO/ co-founder, product, design, and engineering. The right person here cares as much about a fast, considered interface as about the service behind it. The portal is where customers experience the platform, and the difference between a workable workflow and a great one almost always shows up here. What You’ll Do Build and ship features end to end across the stack, from the React and TypeScript portal operators rely on every shift, to the Python services and APIs that power it. Translate logistics problems into products. Partner with PM, design, and operations to turn messy real-world workflows into interfaces and systems that fit how customers actually run their business. Contribute to system design and architectural decisions across the platform, balancing reliability, security, and scalability against the speed the business needs. Write clean, well-tested code, drive thoughtful code reviews, and raise the bar on engineering standards across the team. Debug and resolve production issues across frontend and backend, with the automated tests and observability that catch problems before customers do. Build responsive, high-performance interfaces with a sharp eye for latency, loading and error states, and the edge cases that decide whether an operator trusts the product. Support a strong engineering culture through mentorship, thoughtful reviews, and shared ownership of technical standards. What You’ll Bring 4+ years building and shipping full-stack web applications in production. 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production systems is a plus. Strong React skills (or equivalent modern frameworks), with deep working knowledge of TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and component-driven architecture. Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend frameworks. Experience designing and working with GraphQL and RESTful APIs, relational databases (PostgreSQL), and familiarity with NoSQL stores. Comfort working in microservices or service-oriented architectures. Solid system design, coding, and testing skills on both sides of the stack. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern deployment practices. Product sense and craft. You care about how things feel, not just whether they work. Strong communicator who collaborates well across product, design, operations, and data, and can drive ambiguous problems to a clear outcome. High agency in a fast-paced environment. Mentorship instincts: experience growing other engineers through reviews, pairing, or technical leadership is a plus. Strong preference for the Bay Area. Nash runs a hybrid-first product team out of our San Francisco office. Bonus Experience with Flask, SQLAlchemy, or WebSockets. Background in integration-heavy or real-time systems. Prior startup experience (not required). Why This Role Matters The Nash portal is how the world’s largest retailers, grocers, and pharmacies actually run their logistics: where every order is visible, every delivery in motion is tracked, and every route optimization plays out in front of the team responsible for it. The portal you build will be the daily home base for dispatchers, operators, and merchant teams, on the day a normal Tuesday stays quiet, and on the day a storm closes half the routes. A better portal means better decisions, faster recoveries, and more promises kept. If you want to build full-stack products that meet the real, messy, physical world, and to see your work compound across every retailer and fleet that runs on Nash, this is the role. More about Nash Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics. Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line. Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion. We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it. Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco. What You’ll Love About Us ✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career! ✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates ✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity ✅ Flexible paid time off ✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.description: About Us At TeamSnap , we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “ Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “ 100 Best Remote-First Places to Work." TeamSnap is seeking a Senior Fullstack Engineer (BE-leaning) interested in working across the stack to join our fully distributed engineering team to help us continue our impressive growth from 2+ million daily active users to beyond! Our stack primarily includes Node.js, TypeScript, React.js and SQL. As an engineering team, we design and build scalable systems using a service-oriented and event-driven architecture that serve millions of daily users and some of the largest youth and amateur sports organizations in the world. Our team values collaboration in a remote culture, so we regularly participate in pair sessions and virtual team swarms to stay connected and improve the team and company. What You'll Do: Develop engaging experiences for our millions of users across our mobile and web applications. Design and implement scalable apps and services, integrating these into an evolving unified product and system architecture. Brainstorm and evaluate new product features in collaboration with the product and UX team. Collaborate and pair with other developers to develop solutions and teach technical skills. Contribute to our development standards within the team and across engineering to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for improvement Champion and implement automated testing practices to uphold the dependability and stability of backend systems, while also taking ownership of the overall reliability of the team's services. Actively engage in on-call responsibilities and contribute to incident management efforts. Evaluate and test new technologies to help TeamSnap move faster or serve our users more effectively. Help teammates overcome obstacles, resolve blockers, and complete work tasks. What Will Set You Up for Success: 5+ years of relevant experience, leading large projects on high-scale, distributed software systems as a software engineer Proficient in full stack development with Node, Python, Golang, Ruby, Javascript utilizing React or similar. Experience with direct usage of SQL and relational databases such as MySQL / GCP Cloud SQL along with migrations, profiling, and optimization of such databases. Hands-on experience developing APIs, services for mobile applications and web clients at scale. Successfully delivered complex projects including debugging problems that may span a number of systems. Experience working with and architecting APIs, event streams, webhooks , etc. Experience working within and towards a distributed system. Extra points if you’ve built services for livestreaming, advertising, or subscriptions. Compensation Additional Information Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here. Compensation We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $150,000 , inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Location TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time. Opportunities to Grow At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it. Total Rewards • We're proud to be remote-first . We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool • Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary) • 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family • 401K to help you invest for the future • $1,500 annual learning and development stipend • Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events • Generous home office allowance to set you up for success • TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter • A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more! • TeamSnap Total Rewards Working at TeamSnap At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values. Inclusion and Diversity Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Engineer, Care (Fullstack/Backend)
jobs.description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: We are seeking a visionary and technically exceptional Sr. Staff Engineer to lead architectural innovation and strategic technical direction. This individual will operate at the organizational level, shaping the long-term technical landscape, enabling cross-functional execution at scale, and aligning engineering efforts with product and business outcomes. You Will: Architectural Vision & Strategy Define and evolve the architectural vision for customer-facing systems in alignment with business strategy. Lead cross-org initiatives that address long-term scale, system boundaries, and foundational capabilities Technical Leadership & Governance Establish patterns and frameworks that ensure quality, resilience, and operational excellence across the organization. Serve as the authority on design decisions and foster alignment across teams Org-Wide Enablement & Collaboration Collaborate with engineering and product leadership to shape product direction and ensure our architecture supports strategic goals. Drive org-wide adoption of scalable practices, tools, and development norms Mentorship & Talent Growth Mentor senior technical leaders, elevating engineering capabilities across the organization. Champion initiatives that foster talent density, engineering rigor, and a culture of continuous learning Ambiguity Navigation & Execution Acceleration Lead through complexity and ambiguity, clarifying direction where ownership is unclear. Remove organizational blockers, simplify decision-making, and accelerate delivery of strategic initiatives Customer-Centric Engineering Translate customer needs and product goals into scalable technical solutions. Define principles and patterns that embed customer obsession into our platform’s architecture Sustainability & Scalability Design systems and team boundaries to support sustainable growth. Drive investment in non-functional priorities (e.g., observability, migrations, reliability) early in the design process You Have: 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong record of group-level technical leadership. Experience with technologies such as Kotlin, Java or Go, with a deep understanding of system design for scale and performance. Full-stack capability with frontend proficiency in modern frameworks and libraries (React, Next, GraphQL) Experience introducing and scaling shared infrastructure, frameworks, or libraries across multiple teams. Proficiency with CI/CD workflows (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes), and observability tools (e.g., Datadog). Demonstrated ability to drive architectural clarity and strategic technical alignment across functions. Experience translating customer and clinical needs into reliable, maintainable, and high-impact technical solutions. A track record of driving meaningful improvements in developer experience, team velocity, and system sustainability. You’ll Thrive Here If You: Create alignment and momentum in ambiguous or complex technical spaces. Balance short-term deliverables with long-term scalability, system health, and customer experience. Lead with curiosity, adaptability, and principled decision-making. Take initiative to address cross-squad blockers, scale constraints, or misaligned priorities before they escalate. Drive consistent, action-oriented execution even without perfect clarity. Mentor senior engineering talent and reinforce a culture of growth, feedback, and high technical standards. Inspire confidence through transparency, humility, and deep technical credibility. Advocate for customers through scalable, resilient design that anticipates clinical complexity and future scale. Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights): Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 401k benefits with employer matching contribution Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address. To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement .

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | United Kingdom | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend The Opportunity: Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem. As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana. You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise. AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What You’ll Be Doing: Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability. Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs. Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities. Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands. Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk. Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through. Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work. Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities. Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need. Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work. Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes. Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions. What Makes You a Great Fit Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly. A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers. A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands. Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes. Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation. An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams. Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. Bonus Points For Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems. Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions. Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products. Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations. Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product. Compensation & Rewards: In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949 - GBP 141,539. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .
